newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rate rises must be matched by economic pickup--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Rate rises must be matched by economic pickup--BOJ.

text.p: Any rise in interest rates should be accompanied by a pickup in economic activity, Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Friday.
"When there is an overall rise in interest rates, a matching rise in the level of economic activity is a prerequisite," Matsushita said in a prepared speech.

Commenting on criticism of the central bank's current monetary policy of keeping rates low, Matsushita said if official rates were raised before economic activity had stregthened sufficiently and this had a negative effect on the economy, longer-term market rates would end up falling.
"If that happens, we can't really say for certain what would happen to the average deposit rate including both short- and long-term rates," he said.
